title: Tech Note: Code Optimization Based on Array Use

historical_commentary.text: 4D still supports both interpreted and compiled execution today, so the general question of how array algorithm choices affect performance remains relevant, though the specific micro-optimizations from 2002 have likely been superseded by newer, more efficient array/collection commands and a much faster modern 4D compiler and interpreter.
related_updates: 4D's interpreter and compiler have both been substantially optimized since 2002, and newer collection-based commands offer alternatives to some classic array-optimization techniques
